title: Upload an EPANET model and reach a ready state
description: This test verifies that a valid EPANET .inp file can be uploaded from the landing page and the network becomes ready for analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET .inp file
Submit the upload
Verify the uploaded network is ready for analysis
Verify a dashboard-ready state is displayed

title: Run Ultra Optimize and view the optimization results
description: This test verifies that a user can select Ultra Optimize, provide a target PRV setting, run the workflow, and review the resulting diameter and pressure outputs.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET .inp file
Submit the upload
Select the Ultra Optimize strategy
Fill in a valid Target PRV Setting
Run ultra optimization
Verify optimization results are displayed
Verify diameter and pressure analysis results are displayed

title: Switch to the topology visualizer after upload and inspect the schematic
description: This test verifies that an uploaded network can be opened in the Network Topology Visualizer and the schematic is shown for the model.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET .inp file
Submit the upload
Select the Network Topology Visualizer strategy
Verify the network schematic visualization is displayed
Verify the uploaded model is represented in the visualizer

title: Move between landing and dashboard without losing the uploaded model
description: This test verifies that a user can switch between Landing and Dashboard views and keep the uploaded network available for further workflows.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET .inp file
Submit the upload
Switch to the Landing view
Switch back to the Dashboard view
Verify the uploaded network is still available
Verify workflow selection remains available

title: Run manual loop analysis after uploading a network
description: This test verifies that a user can upload an EPANET network, select the manual loop analysis workflow, and see the Hardy Cross output rendered successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET network file
Select the manual loop analysis strategy
Verify the loop analysis output is displayed
Verify the analysis results are visible

title: Reject a missing file selection before analysis
description: This test verifies that trying to upload without selecting a file keeps analysis unavailable and shows a validation response.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Submit the upload without selecting a file
Verify an upload validation error is visible
Verify the network is not ready for analysis

title: Open manual loop analysis from the dashboard workflow selector
description: This test verifies that a user can upload a network and choose the manual loop analysis workflow from the main page after upload.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET network file
Open the workflow selector
Select the manual loop analysis strategy
Verify the loop analysis workflow is active
Verify the analysis output area is displayed

title: Switch from landing to dashboard after upload
description: This test verifies that a user can move from the landing view into the dashboard after uploading a network and keep access to analysis workflows.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET network file
Select the dashboard view
Verify the dashboard is displayed
Verify the uploaded model remains available

title: Run Manual Loop Analysis and review the Hardy Cross output
description: This test verifies that a user can open Manual Loop Analysis after uploading a model and inspect the loop calculation output.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET .inp file
Submit the upload
Select Manual Loop Analysis
Run the loop analysis
Verify Hardy Cross loop output is displayed
Verify loop analysis results are visible

title: Return to landing without losing the uploaded network
description: This test verifies that a user can switch back to the landing view after uploading a network and still retain the model for later analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET network file
Select the dashboard view
Switch back to the landing view
Verify the landing view is displayed
Verify the uploaded model remains available

title: Review manual loop analysis for a reuploaded network
description: This test verifies that a user can upload one network, replace it with another valid network, and still run manual loop analysis on the latest model.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET network file
Upload another valid EPANET network file
Select the manual loop analysis strategy
Verify the loop analysis output is displayed
Verify the results correspond to the current uploaded model

title: Reject an unsupported file type
description: This test verifies that a non-.inp file cannot be used to start analysis and the app keeps the upload state invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a file with an unsupported type
Submit the upload
Verify a file type validation error is visible
Verify the network is not ready for analysis

title: Require a network before manual loop analysis can run
description: This test verifies that the manual loop analysis workflow cannot be executed until a valid network has been uploaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the manual loop analysis strategy
Verify a missing upload validation message is visible
Verify the loop analysis output is not displayed

title: Require a Target PRV Setting before running Ultra Optimize
description: This test verifies that Ultra Optimize cannot proceed when the target PRV value is omitted and a validation message is shown instead.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Upload a valid EPANET .inp file
Submit the upload
Select the Ultra Optimize strategy
Run ultra optimization without entering a target PRV setting
Verify a Target PRV Setting validation error is visible
Verify optimization results are not displayed

title: See an empty state before any network is uploaded
description: This test verifies that the app shows an empty upload state and does not present analysis output before a network file is provided.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify an empty upload state is displayed
Verify analysis output is not displayed
